newsitem.title: UK: GKN shares drop to near 11-month low.
newsitem.headline: GKN shares drop to near 11-month low.

text.p: Shares in engineering and automotive group GKN Plc dropped on Thursday amid talk that one brokerage had been trying to unload a line of stock in the market, dealers said.
"There is no negative news, it is just a bit of stock washing around," said one market-maker in GKN shares.
Weighed down by recent talk of weak demand in the automotive sector and pressure on exporters from the strong pound, the stock was down 14p at 922-1/2 by 0801 GMT in thin trade of 36,700 shares.
Having dropped steadily through the past month, the stock was close to its 11-month low of 908p set on February 20.
"Engineering stocks are underperforming in general," said one dealer. "It is just a stale stock on market-makers' books and they are trying to get it down to a level where there is some interest."
